proposals.announcement_evidence: in support of the Ohio Replacement Program
proposals.rationale: The award buys preliminary design, detailed design, prototype manufacture and qualification testing of the thin line towed array handling system explicitly 'in support of the Ohio Replacement Program', and obligates fiscal 2016 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funding. PE 0603595N is the Ohio Replacement RDT&E line itself -- its program_title in the index is literally 'Ohio Replacement' -- and the narrative name that line owns for the work is 'COLUMBIA Class Submarine Development'. Ohio Replacement is the pre-2016 designation of the Columbia class, not a string resemblance: it is the same program office and the same line. Appropriation agrees: design/prototype development is RDT&E work and this award obligates RDT&E,N, whereas the SCN Columbia line (1045, doc 341) would be the wrong colour for pre-construction design. The towed-array handling system is the development program's own payload-handling scope, not a platform the contract merely supports.

refute_a.reason: Money and mission agree: the award obligates fiscal 2016 RDT&E,N against an RDT&E PE whose own program_title is 'Ohio Replacement', and preliminary/detailed design, prototype manufacture and qualification test of the new class's towed-array handling system on the Electric Boat class design contract (SUPSHIP Groton) is that development line's own scope, not O&M or procurement work and not a platform the contract merely supports.

refute_b.reason: The alias is real and index-anchored, not invented: 'Ohio Replacement' is literally 0603595N's own program_title (the pre-2016 designation of Columbia), and the only competing owner of the Columbia name, 1045 'COLUMBIA Class Submarine' (doc 341, SCN), carries no 'Ohio' string anywhere in its rows, so the announcement's own words pick exactly one owner; no other index row claims a submarine towed-array handling system (the SURTASS/TAGOS 'towed array' rows are T-AGOS surveillance ships, a different thing), and a July 2016 preliminary/detailed design and prototype effort cannot read as the SCN hull line's work.

proposals.announcement_evidence: fleet implementation of digital video surveillance system
proposals.rationale: The contract is for engineering and technical services of design, development, fabrication, test, delivery and fleet implementation of the digital video surveillance system, and it obligates fiscal 2025 other procurement (Navy) and fiscal 2023 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds. Exactly one row of this org's index owns that name -- 'Digital Video Surveillance System (DVSS)' on BLI 0900 (DDG Mod), an OPN shipboard-modernization line -- so there is no alternative owner to weigh. The product named is the line's own procured item rather than a platform the contract supports, and the OPN/SCN money colour is consistent with a shipboard modernization installation line. The one caveat for the refute lenses: the announcement does not itself name the DDG class, so the tie rests on the uniqueness of the DVSS name in the index plus the procurement colour.

refute_a.reason: Refuted on money weight and mission: 91% of the obligated dollars ($3,391,474 FY2023 shipbuilding and conversion vs $346,840 FY2025 OPN) is new-construction SCN money that does not execute the OPN DDG Modernization line, and the announcement names neither DDG, the class, nor the modernization program -- the only scope it states is fleetwide ('fleet implementation of digital video surveillance system'), i.e. installations spread across classes and accounts, so the record gives no basis to say this action paid for BLI 0900's own work rather than for one of several funding homes for a shipboard system.

refute_b.reason: A full-index search finds exactly one owner of this name -- 'Digital Video Surveillance System (DVSS)' on 0900 (DDG Mod) -- with no collision anywhere in N.tsv: the nearest strings are 'Digital Video Map Computer' (0204136N, an F/A-18 cockpit item), 'Tactical Video Capture System' (6532) and 'Remote Video Viewing Terminal' (4640/0206313M), none of which is a shipboard video surveillance system, and the announcement's 'digital video surveillance system' is a verbatim case-insensitive match to the index name rather than an inferred alias, with no variant or increment named on either side that could split the identity; the residual worry that 'fleet implementation' plus FY23 SCN money may reach hulls beyond DDG Mod is a scope-and-appropriation question for lens A, not an alternative-owner question, because no other index row owns DVSS.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for post-shakedown availabilities (PSA) for USS Gabrielle Giffords (LCS 10) and USS Omaha (LCS 12)
proposals.rationale: The modification exercises options for the post-shakedown availabilities of two named LCS hulls, and the announcement's own text ties the work to the shipbuilding account: PSAs run 'between the time of ship custody transfer to the Navy and the shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) obligation work limiting date'. Post-shakedown availability is contractually part of delivering the ship and is funded from the hull's SCN line, so this is the SCN Littoral Combat Ship line's own work, not O&M sustainment bolted onto a procurement line. The designator LCS 10 / LCS 12 normalizes onto the index name 'Littoral Combat Ship (LCS)'. The collision with 0603581N (the LCS RDT&E PE) is resolved by money colour: a shipbuilding availability executes 2127 (doc 341), not the development PE. Distinguish this from record 65, which is O&M fleet sustainment on the same platform and is proposed wrong.

refute_a.reason: Money and mission agree: the full funding sentence is FY2017 SCN $13,786,204 plus FY2012 SCN $5,999,684 plus FY2017 OPN $1,445,382 -- 93% shipbuilding and conversion against an SCN line (doc 341) -- and the PSA is contractually part of delivering LCS 10 and LCS 12 (correcting government-responsible trial card deficiencies and incorporating engineering changes not installed during construction, before the SCN obligation work limiting date), which is the hull line's own post-delivery work, not O&M fleet sustainment bolted onto a procurement line.

refute_b.reason: There is a genuine collision -- the identical string 'Littoral Combat Ship (LCS)' is also a name row under 0603581N (doc 340, RDT&E) -- but the evidence does not link equally well there: the announcement names two delivered, commissioned hulls by designator (LCS 10, LCS 12) and a post-shakedown availability bounded by 'the shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) obligation work limiting date', and hulls are what doc 341's line buys, whereas 0603581N's sibling rows are development articles (Combat Management System, Decoy Launching System, Gun Weapon System, STAVE) and never a hull; the other LCS lines are also worse fits (1604 'LCS In-Service Modernization' is post-PSA OPN modernization, 0944 is class support equipment, and the index contains no post-delivery/outfitting line at all), and the identity is a designator normalization, not a contractor name.

proposals.program_name: EA-18G AEA System Enhancements (ASE) and Integrated Capability Package (ICP-3)
proposals.announcement_evidence: This order provides for Airborne Electronic Attack (AEA) System enhancements to the ALQ-218 receiver system hardware
proposals.lexicon_quote: EA-18G AEA System Enhancements (ASE) and Integrated Capability Package (ICP-3)

refute_a.reason: Refuted on appropriation: the untruncated text obligates 'Fiscal 2018 aircraft procurement (Navy); and foreign military sales funds in the amount of $24,400,000' with no RDT&E,N at all, while 0604269N is an RDT&E PE (doc 340) -- and the work (modifying 13 delivered sets of WRA-7/8/9 and 18 AEA gun bay pallets and writing the associated technical directives) is retrofit of fielded hardware, i.e. APN modification work whose home in this same index is BLI 0505 'F-18E/F and EA-18G Modernization and Sustainment' (doc 330); procurement money attached to a development line is precisely the failure mode lens A exists to catch, and the cost-plus-incentive-fee structure does not override the stated money colour.

refute_b.reason: The announcement never names ASE, ICP-3 or any increment -- it spells out the generic expansion 'Airborne Electronic Attack (AEA) System enhancements', which matches the program_title of a DIFFERENT index owner, 0513 'AEA Systems' (doc 330), at least as directly as it matches the long compound name on 0604269N, and the work described (modifying thirteen sets of WRA-7/8/9 and eighteen AEA gun bay pallets and writing the associated technical directives, with Australia participating) is aircraft modification-kit work that 0505 'F-18E/F and EA-18G Modernization and Sustainment' owns through its own row 'Growler Capability Modification (GCM)'; with three in-index owners fitting the same words and no increment named to separate them -- and no appropriation visible in the record text to settle it -- the evidence would link this award equally well elsewhere.

proposals.program_name: AN/SPS-48G RADAR OBSOLESCENCE AND AVAILABILITY RECOVERY (ROAR)

proposals.announcement_evidence: in support of the Marine Corps Expeditionary Airfield emergent requirements
